name: Achensee Strandbad
kurzbeschreibung: Strandbad Maurach at Atoll Achensee offers 100 meters of natural gravel beach, crystal-clear water, and a great family paradise on the southern shore of Achensee.
beschreibung:
Overview

The SEE-Bad at the Atoll Achensee leisure centre (Achenseeweg 10, 6212 Eben am Achensee, district Buchau) offers 100 metres of natural shoreline and beach with gently sloping sand and gravel directly on the southern shore of Achensee. The water on the south shore is among the warmest parts of the entire lake, reaching up to 22 °C in midsummer. The 13,400 m² sunbathing lawn invites visitors to relax with shade trees and sun decks.

Facilities & Highlights

The SEE-Bad features three bathing piers, a large adventure playground with the wooden play ship St. Benedikt, climbing course, sand play area, beach volleyball court, and table tennis tables. SUP rental and wingfoil courses are also available. The Beach Bar and restaurant Lagoon provide catering; hot showers, changing cabins, and lockers are provided.

Visit & Arrival

Open from early June to late September daily 09:00–19:00 (during bathing weather). Admission is free after 17:00. Day ticket (2025/26 season): adults €8.00, youths 11–15 years €7.00, children 6–10 years €6.00, children 0–5 years free; family ticket €22.00. Season ticket adults €104.00. By car: A12 exit Wiesing/Achensee, B181 to Maurach, follow signs to Atoll Achensee. By public transport: ÖBB to Jenbach, VVT bus line 4080 to stop Maurach Atoll Achensee.

Tips

The Atoll grounds and the SEE-Bad are barrier-free and wheelchair accessible; people with a disability pass (with mark "B") receive a discount. The adjacent Panorama-BAD (indoor pool and sauna) is open year-round daily 10:00–22:00 – ideal for cooler days or the off-season.
